notes.title: BREAK ARTS III Out Now! Mech Customization Contest Now Underway!
notes.notes:
[p][i][b]BREAK ARTS III[/b][/i][b] has finally launched![/b]  [/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the release, we’re holding a two week limited-time launch sale. During this period, both the base game and the original soundtrack featuring 9 tracks from the game will be available at 10% off! In addition, a special bundle that includes both the game and soundtrack will receive an extra additional 5% discount. Don’t miss this chance to enjoy not only the game itself but also the music that brings it to life. [/p][p][/p][p]On Steam News, we’re also running a series of guide articles that go beyond introducing the basics of the game, offering deeper insights such as advanced techniques for mecha customization. These guides will continue to be updated regularly, so be sure to check back for the latest tips and strategies. [/p][p][/p][p]We’re also excited to announce a Mecha Customization Contest honoring player creativity![/p][p]The most outstanding entries will be featured on the official PLAYISM website, Steam News, and in a special livestream hosted by mecha-loving VTuber Kisa. Plus participants will receive in-game items that can’t be obtained anywhere else. Show off your best mecha or diorama creation![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2522430/BREAK_ARTS_III/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]  [/p][h1]▼Contest Overview[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44526080/27161e7ec26e9fd8111ac6f23d43d4d0773a0adf.png"][/img][/p][p]
Submission Period：September 19, 2025 – October 20, 2025
How to Enter：Choose one of the following methods:[/p][p]① Post a screenshot along with the title of your work and a short message in the dedicated thread on the Steam Community.
② Post a screenshot on X（formerly Twitter）with both hashtags #BreakArts and #BA3Customs, including the title of your work and a short message.[/p][p]Results Announcement：November 2025[/p][p]Winners will be announced on the official PLAYISM Website, Steam News, and during Kisa’s livestream. In addition to the winning entries, many unique nominated works that didn’t make the final cut will also be showcased in Kisa’s program, your creation could be among them…![/p][p][b]▼Judging Criteria[/b][/p][p]Entries will be judged based on the following points: [/p][list][*][p]Clarity of theme or message[/p][/*][*][p]Creativity and overall design quality[/p][/*][*][p]Composition and presentation of the screenshot[/p][/*][/list][p]Awards will be primarily selected by MercuryStudio (developer), PLAYISM (publisher), and special guest judge VTuber Kisa. Some prizes, however, will be determined by community voting (based on “likes”), so we encourage everyone to participate and support their favorite entries.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44526080/b97f0225978222494a2b1fb9ec3bd8db21233cee.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][b]Special Judge: VTuber Kisa[/b][/p][p]
Greetings! I’m Kisa, a chill tea-party VTuber who loves mechas and delicious food! In my streams, I aim to provide a cozy, fun, and tasty haven, sprinkled with a touch of Kansai Dialect.
[/p][p]To celebrate the launch of [i]BREAK ARTS III, [/i]I’ll be serving as a special judge for the Mecha Customization Contest! I’ll also be streaming gameplay, including commentary sessions and online battle matches where players can join in, so feel free to stop by and watch![/p][p]And above all, I’m looking forward to seeing all the machines packed with your quirks and passions![/p][p][/p][p][i]Youtube Channel：[/i][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@KisaVtuber"][/dynamiclink][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]   [/p][p] [b]【How to Enter & Important Notes][/b][/p][list][*][p]When submitting your entry, please be sure to include a message describing the concept or theme behind your work. [/p][/*][*][p][b]For the Mecha Design Category, entries must include a screenshot showing the entire machine,  (video submissions are also accepted). [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiple entries are allowed; however, duplicate awards within the same category will not be given.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]▼Prizes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Grand Prize (2 winners per category): Your winning design will be featured on the Steam Store page! Hello, Artists!
The wait is over.
[i]SOUNDART[/i] v1.4.0 is now officially available!

Major additions are two new beautiful and unique stages and the “Giant Stick”, which lets your avatars become sticks themselves.

[b]Update details[/b]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] New stick type "Giant" added.
[*] New Stage "NECTAR" and "CANDY" added.
[*] New music added.
[/list]

[b]Changes/Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Unity and other plugins updated.
[*] Adjusted the color change of stages to produce more beautiful results.
[*] Adjusted avatar movement to be more natural.
[*] Adjusted camera angles.
[*] Changed system so inputs are not registered while loading in music files. This is to prevent bugs occurring.
[*] Changed the VRM file loading to search for files that exist in the folder rather than searching for a specific file name.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where the screen goes dark in first person mode under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed the bug where the bokeh effect before starting play was only working for the auto camera.
[*] Fixed the UI bug that occurs when you start a game with the stage color settings still open.
[*] Fixed the bug where the Note hit effect was occurring in places that it should not.
[/list]

notes.title: Build v1.1.2 (beta) Update.
notes.notes:
Dear Artists!
Thank you for all of the helpful feedback on the previous update.

There were a lot of comments on the distance between the sticks and the Flower.

The previous distance increased the distance between the sticks and the flower in the hopes that the Notes would be more visible, however this has resulted in an increase in miss hits.

Saying that, there are a lot of comments saying the Notes are indeed easier to follow now so we are looking for an effective middle ground between the two issues.

To gather user feedback on this we will be holding an open beta to see how you, the users, feel. You can join in by selecting the “openBeta” option from the beta tab  in properties.

We look forward to your comments regarding Note visibility and the sense of distance from the stick to the Flower.

[h3]build1.1.2 beta1[/h3]

[b]Update Details：[/b]

notes.title: VR Rhythm Game SoundArt released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/098486e02d1e5d334133ab871585beec0882c8f0.jpg[/img]

Dear Fans,

Mercury Studio, a one man studio which created the popular battle racing games Break Arts and Break Arts II is back with SoundArt, a brand new title!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36254969/804e2609c6524af14d3260fbfb77aa27f5724a36.png[/img]

[h3][b]Exhilirating Rhythm Action[/b][/h3]
Hit, sweep and thrust the blocks that come flying towards you in time with the music.
Maneuver your sticks gracefully and rack up points!

[h3][b]Unlimited Stages[/b][/h3]
Load your own tracks into the game and watch as your favourite tunes become new levels.
Rock and Pop tunes will provide particularly challenging stages! The number of stages si only limited by the size of your music library!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36254969/1a514cf69e837759a7d3f149d11ae883e189cdea.png[/img]

[h3][b]Show me, Show you.[/b][/h3]
Sound Art has a Live Show mode where you can stream and show off your playstyle to a crowd.
With VRM avatar support, with a simple file swap you can play as your favourite avatar.
Also if you're streaming on youtube or twitch, viewer reactions will appear in game so you can connect with your audience!
SoundArt isn't just a game for the one with the VR headset on, it's also for the viewers.

[h3][b]Indie Game Collab Tunes Included![/b][/h3]
Tracks from upcoming crustacean battle game Fight Crab by Nussoft and Touhou Luna Nights have been preloaded!

What kind of levels will these tracks become?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/851100/Touhou_Luna_Nights/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1213750/Fight_Crab/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36254969/2b6192f189b44110f64fa40a68b084517b3b5c35.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy SoundArt, where your performances and music join to become a unique piece of Art.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144460/SOUNDART/
